guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 找到此前登记的 Base 地址
guide.description: XDP 空投 portal 已开放领取，登记已于 2026 年 7 月 30 日关闭。查看 7 月保存的截图或钱包历史，找到当时提交的 Base 地址；只有这个地址可以领取。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Find the Base Address You Registered
guide.original_description: The XDP Airdrop portal is now open for claims. Registration closed on July 30, 2026. Check your saved screenshot or wallet history from July for the Base address you submitted, because only that address can claim.

guide.title: 将登记的 Base 地址导入钱包
guide.description: 确认此前登记的 Base 地址已载入自己控制的 EVM 钱包，例如 MetaMask 或 Rabby。提交的地址无法更改；如果已无法访问登记的钱包地址，获配资产便无法恢复。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Import the Registered Base Address Into Your Wallet
guide.original_description: Make sure the Base address is loaded in an EVM wallet you control, such as MetaMask or Rabby. Submitted addresses cannot be changed, so if you registered an address you can no longer access, the allocation cannot be recovered.

guide.title: 在 Base 网络准备支付手续费所需的 ETH
guide.description: 在 Base 网络保留少量 ETH，用于支付领取交易，以及之后转移或交易 XDP 的手续费。可在 Bybit 购买 ETH 并直接提到 Base，或通过来源页面下方的跨链组件从其他链转入 Base。原文还包含组件宣传：支持 30 多条链，宣称路由快速、费用较低；点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开组件，也可在新标签页打开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Add ETH on Base for Gas
guide.original_description: Keep a small amount of ETH on Base to cover the claim transaction and to move or trade XDP afterwards. You can buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw it directly to Base, or send ETH from another chain to Base with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 获取官方 XDP 合约地址
guide.description: Doppler 文档列出的 Base 网络 XDP 合约地址为 0x07b3D902783c3C12b077508c3B5c00113d1291D0。将其作为自定义代币添加到钱包，不要把其他自称 XDP 的代币当作同一资产。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Get the Official XDP Contract Address
guide.original_description: Doppler’s docs list the XDP contract on Base as 0x07b3D902783c3C12b077508c3B5c00113d1291D0. Add it to your wallet as a custom token, and ignore any other token calling itself XDP.

guide.title: 领取 XDP
guide.description: 打开 XDP 空投 portal，连接此前登记的 Base 地址并签署领取交易。每个地址通过一笔交易领取全部获配数量。领取于 2026 年 11 月 28 日 UTC 时间 12:00 关闭。来源网站的领取页面还列出了其他正在进行的分配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the XDP Airdrop portal, connect your registered Base address and sign the claim transaction. Each address claims its full allocation in one transaction. The claim closes on November 28, 2026, at 12:00 UTC. Other live distributions are listed on our claims page .

guide.title: 向 Doppler 金库存入 XRP，为后续活动做准备
guide.description: 如果错过 Genesis 空投，可从 XRPL 钱包向 Doppler XRP 金库存入 XRP。Doppler 已确认后续 DP 活动，但尚未公布日期和规则，因此现在存入只是提前参与。来源另附空投参与指南，介绍如何在多个计划之间分配活动。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Deposit XRP Into the Doppler Vault for Future Seasons
guide.original_description: If you missed the Genesis Airdrop, deposit XRP from your XRPL wallet into the Doppler XRP Vault . Doppler has confirmed future DP seasons without sharing dates or rules, so a deposit now only positions you early. Our airdrop farming guide covers how to spread activity across programs like this.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
